summary: As a Quality Doc SME, I want to complete the final review task to close the Send for Review workflow so that the document review cycle is formally completed

implicitLinkedIssues.description: Reviewer must complete review task before SME final review task becomes available

acceptanceCriteria.text: The Quality Doc SME can log in to Veeva Vault QualityDocs using valid credentials and is presented with the QualityDocs interface
After login, the Quality Doc SME can navigate to the Home view
The Quality Doc SME's most recently assigned final review workflow task is visible in the Home view
The Quality Doc SME can open the final review task
The task completion form displays a Verdict field
The Quality Doc SME can select "No Changes Required – Review Complete" from the Verdict field options
The Quality Doc SME can click Complete to submit the final review task
After submission, the task is marked as complete and the workflow is closed
The document transitions to Final Review Complete state (workflow ended)
The Quality Doc SME can log out of the application successfully
If the SME has multiple tasks in their Home view, they can identify the most recent one corresponding to the final review step
The Verdict field is mandatory; the system does not allow the final review task to be submitted without a verdict selection
Only the Quality Doc SME assigned to this workflow can complete this final review task; the Reviewer cannot perform this action

HP.description: SME logs in with valid credentials, navigates to Home view, locates most recent final review task, opens task, selects verdict 'No Changes Required – Review Complete', clicks Complete to submit, verifies task marked complete and workflow closed, verifies document transitioned to Final Review Complete state, logs out successfully

AP.description: SME has multiple workflow tasks in Home view and successfully identifies the most recent final review task corresponding to the current workflow instance

NEG.description: User with Reviewer role (not Quality Doc SME) attempts to complete the SME final review task and is prevented by role-based authorization check

ERR.description: SME attempts to submit final review task without selecting a Verdict from the dropdown and system displays mandatory field error

INT.description: Verify that the SME final review task only becomes available after CS-9 (Reviewer review task) has been completed — enforce sequential workflow ordering per RP-NFR-001
